title: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Iloilo Review: Runrio's Night Race in the City of Love
seo_title: HOKA Midnight Run Iloilo 2026 Review | Philippines Night Race
meta_description: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Iloilo: October 25 in Iloilo City. 21K, 10K, 5K from Runrio — a HOKA night race in the Philippines' City of Love.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 in Iloilo City, this HOKA-branded midnight run is produced by Runrio. Three distances. A brand-backed night race in one of the Philippines' most liveable cities.
verdict: HOKA Midnight Run Asia brings the global performance-running brand's night-race concept to Iloilo City — the Philippines' 'City of Love,' known for its Dinagyang festival, heritage houses, and la paz batchoy. Produced by Runrio (the gold standard in Philippine race production), the event offers three distances (21K, 10K, 5K). Registration isn't open yet, but for a Runrio-HOKA collaboration in one of the country's most charming cities, this is a priority track. Iloilo's flat terrain and wide esplanade along the Iloilo River make for a fast, scenic night-race course.

sections.heading: Iloilo: The City of Love
paragraphs: Iloilo is one of the Philippines' most underrated destinations — a city of heritage houses, the Iloilo River Esplanade (one of the country's best running paths), and a food scene that rivals anywhere in the country. [1] A Runrio-HOKA night race through the city's flat, well-lit streets is a premium racing experience in a city that rewards a weekend stay.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A Runrio-HOKA night race in one of the Philippines' most charming cities. Watch runrio.com. 25 October 2026. [1]
